headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

boxes.label: Core
boxes.description: Always-safe built-ins: the server clock, and full reads of this project's knowledge files.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current date and time on the server, optionally in a specific IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Use whenever freshness, "today", or a timezone matters.

tools.name: read_project_file
tools.description: Read an attached source or enabled instruction skill by its name as listed. Skills support offset pagination. For PDFs use startPage/endPage (up to 5 pages) and offset to read beyond summaries; results include page and version references.

boxes.label: Google Drive
boxes.description: Search, read and write files in your connected Google Drive (only files noevia created or was given).
boxes.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_search_files
tools.description: Search the user's Google Drive (files noevia created or was given) by name or text.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file, Google Doc, Sheet (as CSV) or Slides deck from Google Drive, by Drive file id. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_get_metadata
tools.description: Get a Google Drive file's name, type, size, dates and link.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_list_recent
tools.description: List the most recently changed files in Google Drive.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_create_file
tools.description: Create a new text file in the user's Google Drive. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_update_file
tools.description: Replace the whole content of a text file in Google Drive, by Drive file id. Read it with drive_read_file first, in the same reply. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

tools.name: drive_trash_file
tools.description: Move a Google Drive file to the trash (recoverable for 30 days).
tools.reason: Connect this account in Settings → Connected apps first.

boxes.label: Coding harness
boxes.description: Read, edit and run commands in a registered repository. Every edit and command asks first.
boxes.reason: Switch this session to Cowork to use the coding harness.

tools.name: read_repository
tools.description: Read files in the chosen repository.
tools.reason: Switch this session to Cowork to use the coding harness.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Change files on a task branch.
tools.reason: Switch this session to Cowork to use the coding harness.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Run a command in the sandbox.
tools.reason: Switch this session to Cowork to use the coding harness.
